claims: NASA's Artemis program aims to return humans to the Moon, including the first woman and person of color, to establish a long-term presence and prepare for Mars.
Artemis I was a successful uncrewed mission in 2022.
Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby planned for 2026.
Artemis III/IV are planned landings starting in 2027-2028.
This video shows the planned trajectory of the Artemis II mission.
